scientific_integrity: General assertions are proved with Fourier orthogonality and subspace Möbius inversion; finite checks supplement the proof, and classical methods are attributed to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to complete-bipartite graphical groups and finite fields.
The integer Gaussian sum is exact but may involve cancellation; no asymptotic complexity claim is made.
Historical priority has residual uncertainty due to older and unindexed sources; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Rank-resolved laws for repeated commutators in complete-bipartite graphical groups
